name: SteamBee
description: SteamBee is a self-hosted operations console for managing your own Steam accounts, with a browser UI, multi-account control, QR/mobile approval, encrypted refresh-token storage, recovery tooling, notifications, schedules, and local logs. Legacy playtime boosting is a high-risk compatibility feature and may violate Steam or game-service rules.

paths.name: Appdata
paths.description: Dedicated SteamBee data directory. Ownership is validated and initialized automatically for PUID/PGID; do not select the appdata parent.

ports.name: WebUI Port
ports.description: HTTP port for the SteamBee management UI.

variables.name: PUID
variables.description: Numeric user ID used after appdata initialization. Unraid default: 99 (nobody).

variables.name: PGID
variables.description: Numeric group ID used after appdata initialization. Unraid default: 100 (users).

variables.name: Automatic Appdata Permissions
variables.description: Initialize /data ownership for PUID/PGID, then permanently drop root privileges. Keep enabled on Unraid.

variables.name: Trust Proxy
variables.description: Set to 1 for exactly one trusted reverse proxy, or provide trusted IP addresses/CIDRs.

variables.name: Secure Cookie
variables.description: Set to true when SteamBee is served through HTTPS.

variables.name: Log Level
variables.description: Logging level: fatal, error, warn, info, debug, trace, or silent.

variables.name: Quiet Request Logging
variables.description: Suppress routine health and status requests in the logs.

variables.name: Setup Token
variables.description: Optional fixed setup token of 8 to 256 characters. Leave empty to generate one automatically.

variables.name: Event Retention Days
variables.description: Days to retain events. Set to 0 to disable automatic cleanup.
